title: Shift task parser
description: Build a self-contained offline browser app for reviewing one synthetic task message formatted TASK: <text>. A labeled message field and Parse button display the task text and exact original message. Invalid or blank input shows a clear inline error; correcting it and parsing succeeds. Preserve the last successful result across reloads. Use no external services.
criteria: TASK: inspect pump displays inspect pump and the exact source message.
Empty input, TASK: without task text, or a missing prefix shows an inline error, and a valid correction succeeds.
Reload restores the last successful result; the app is keyboard usable and fits a 390px narrow screen.
resources: Use synthetic task messages only. Deliver one self-contained index.html with no package dependencies or network requests.
